title: On Digesting the heavy bread slowly
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：digest　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 digest 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the doctor ① digested the heavy bread slowly with great care, and every patient in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the doctor ② digests the heavy bread slowly on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ digest the heavy bread slowly at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ digested the heavy bread slowly before — a line in the chart for January 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Digesting the heavy bread slowly with great care, the doctor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ digest the report in a single evening on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Digest the report in a single evening at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the chart, and a new patient from the next clinic ⑧ digests the report in a single evening with great care every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ digested the heavy bread slowly again when nobody else would.

⑩ To digest the heavy bread slowly, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the clinic remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the clinic forgets, somebody digests the heavy bread slowly on the same day again and somebody must digest the heavy bread slowly with great care all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 消化（一般过去式 digested the heavy bread slowly：1986 年大夫头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 消化（一般现在 digests the heavy bread slowly：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 消化（不定式 to digest the heavy bread slowly：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 消化（过去完成时 had digested the heavy bread slowly：1980 年一月的病历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 消化（动名词 digesting the heavy bread slowly 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 领会（digest the report in a single evening：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去领会一个晚上把报告吃透）
G. v. 领会（digest the report in a single evening：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 消化（后段两处：新来的病人照例 digests the report in a single evening，而母亲又一次 digested the heavy bread slowly）

digest 意为“消化”，自那以后大夫当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 digests。
digest 意为“消化”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯消化慢慢地消化那种粗面包”，此处为不定式 to digest the heavy bread slowly。
digest 意为“消化”，病历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人消化过，故用过去完成时 had digested。

digest 意为“领会”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去领会一个晚上把报告吃透”，should ever 之后用原形 digest the report in a single evening。
digest 意为“领会”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻领会一个晚上把报告吃透（digest the report in a single evening at once），以后再也不要提起。
digest 意为“消化”，新来的病人每个星期都照例领会一个晚上把报告吃透，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 digests。
digest 意为“消化”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地消化慢慢地消化那种粗面包，用一般过去式 digested 叙述。
digest 意为“消化”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要消化慢慢地消化那种粗面包，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和卫生所记住的那一件。

answers: In 1986 the doctor digested the heavy bread slowly with great care, and nobody in the clinic forgot it.
Even now the doctor digests the heavy bread slowly on the same day whenever the clinic asks.
